typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white
typography.trust_indicator: text-sm font-medium text-white flex items-center gap-2
rules: No generic AI-style fonts for headings.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Keep text large and readable on iPhone screens.

hero_section.mobile: flex flex-col gap-8 px-4 pt-12 pb-8
hero_section.desktop: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center min-h-[80vh] px-8
hero_section.alignment: left-aligned text content, right-aligned or bottom-stacked phone mockups

transfer_animation.description: Framer Motion sequence demonstrating 50€ transfer from Afrim to Albin. A floating pill or coin should animate from Phone 1 (Afrim) to Phone 2 (Albin).

motion.buttons: Hover scale up 1.05 and soft glow

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use glass-premium (backdrop-blur-xl with subtle white/10 borders) for phone mockups.
visual_enhancers.glows: Subtle #00C2FF radial gradients behind the phone mockups to separate them from the dark background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a new component P2PHeroSection.jsx and import it at the top of HomePage.jsx.
Move the existing 'Bitcoin Mining Proof' section further down the page.
Make P2PHeroSection the very first visible component below the navigation header.
Ensure all existing props (onNavigate, onLogin, onRegister, etc.) are passed down or preserved so current auth/navigation flows remain fully functional.
Implement a 'How it Works' section directly below the Hero.

hero.headline: Geld senden. Geld empfangen. In Sekunden.
hero.subheadline: Sende Geld direkt an Freunde, Familie oder Geschäftspartner – per Telefonnummer, QR-Code oder BidBlitz-ID. Einfach, sicher und rund um die Uhr. (Nur zwischen BidBlitz Wallet Nutzern).

steps.title: Geld angekommen
steps.desc: Der Empfänger erhält sofort eine Bestätigung

translation_notes: Ensure i18n hooks are used for these strings so they are fully translated into all existing BidBlitz languages.
Do NOT claim 'guaranteed in one second'. Always use 'in Sekunden'.

afrim_avatar.description: Professional young man, used for Afrim (Sender)

albin_avatar.description: Smiling young man, used for Albin (Receiver)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over dark backgrounds meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='hero-register-btn').
accessibility.animations: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the phone transfer animation.

testing.responsive: Must test on 320px, 390px, and desktop widths. Use stacked layout on mobile and side-by-side on desktop.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Ensure the hero phone mockups look professional, clean, and minimal. Do not use random AI-generated vector illustrations. Build them with pure HTML/Tailwind.
Avoid complete transparent backgrounds on floating elements.
